selectionEntries.comment:
GS39 PRACTICE: Practice now uses the exact same Extra Unit Copy Cost branch as Quick: four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. The Practice branch below is derived from the current Quick branch; Standard and Long arithmetic are unchanged.

EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / GS37. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent. Rubric Marines (3), Tzaangors (9), current Arsenal Legionaries (5), and current Arsenal Cultists (10) remain four independent Troop copy families. Five native non-Rare Other families plus the twenty eligible Great Traitors’ Arsenal Other families retain their established accounting; Rare Arsenal units remain outside the soft-copy ledger. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 3 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other. Each excess identical copy adds 20 Points.

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## Thousand Sons 3.3.5

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

## Changelog (September 24th)

• Presentation: replaced unit-row chevrons with ◆ and improved spacing in roster exports.

## Changelog (September 23rd)

• 420 Point Practice: now uses 0 Leader Points and Quick-equivalent Extra Unit Copy Cost allowances; LP-costing units are hidden unless already selected.

## Changelog (September 21st)

• Standardized Configuration ordering across the listbuilder.

## Changelog (September 19th)

• Added 420 Point Practice support and the current Unit Ability/list presentation.
• Icon of Flame and Mutating Horrors now show their Unit Abilities only when their matching upgrades are selected.
• Great Traitors’ Arsenal: synchronized to the current Chaos Space Marines library while preserving existing Leader Point, Rare, attachment, and copy-cost behavior.

## Changelog (September 16th)

• Added source model-count suffixes to Rubric Marines, Tzaangors, Scarab Occult Terminators, Tzaangor Enlightened, and Sekhetar Robots.
• Leader Points added to Exalted Sorcerer, Discborne Exalted Sorcerer, Infernal Master, Time Cult Sorcerer, and Tzaangor Shaman; Scarab Occult Sorcerer and Aspiring Sorcerer remain 0 LP.
• Great Traitors’ Arsenal is now fully supported through Configuration and participates in the correct Troop / Other Extra Unit Copy Costs.
• Mutating Horrors, Hellfyre Missile Rack, and Icon of Flame now use checkbox-style upgrade/wargear selections.
• Cleaned Loadout Options presentation for Ahzek Ahriman and Sekhetar Robots.

REV23 adopts GS39 Practice: 0 LP, selected-safe hiding for LP-costing units, and Quick-equivalent copy thresholds.

catalogue.comment:
REV28 / GS40 — FINAL SHARED-LIBRARY REFERENCE REFRESH
Updated only the present-tense Great Traitors’ Arsenal library reference from historical V20 to current V28. Historical synchronization notes remain unchanged. No executable mechanics changed.

REV27 / GS40 — UPDATED DATE HEADER FIX
Corrected the Configuration display header from `Updated: September 23rd` to `Updated: September 24th` so it matches the existing September 24 Changelog entry. No player-facing Changelog wording, IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice behavior, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV26 / GS40 — CURRENT-STATE DOCUMENTATION REFRESH
Corrected only the present-tense CURRENT STATE documentation to the live GS40 state. Practice copy allowances now reflect the GS39+ Quick-equivalent 4 Troop / 1 Other baseline where the stale GS37 text still described 3 / 0. Historical revision notes and separate shared-library/version references remain unchanged for their own audit passes. No IDs, targets, costs, LP objects or modifiers, constraints, associations, loadouts, category ownership, copy-cost arithmetic, Practice hiding logic, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV25 / GS40 — DIAMOND PRESENTATION CATCH-UP + CHANGELOG CLEANUP
Applied the missed Thousand Sons unit-row presentation migration from chevrons to `◆  ` throughout catalogue-owned display strings and mirrored childName references, using the same two-space export convention as the current live catalogues. Renamed the player-facing maintenance history to Changelog and consolidated overlapping dated entries. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, Arsenal targets, copy-cost arithmetic, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV24 / GS40 — PRACTICE DESCRIPTION CLEANUP COMPATIBILITY
Retargeted to Game System revision 40 after removal of redundant construction-summary text from the 420 Point Practice description. No catalogue-local executable data changed in this revision: Practice LP visibility, explicit 0-LP attachment-only exceptions where present, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, points, IDs, loadouts, associations, and all unit mechanics remain unchanged.

REV23 / GS39 — PRACTICE ZERO-LP MIGRATION
This component now targets Game System revision 39. Every locally owned unit root carrying a positive LP cost receives selected-safe Practice hiding: it is hidden while 420 Point Practice is active only when that unit is not already selected. Explicit 0-LP roots do not exist under the project convention, so no exception tags are required. The local Extra Unit Copy Costs Practice branch is now an exact clone of the current Quick branch, giving Practice four normal-cost Troop copies and one normal-cost Other copy. Points, intrinsic LP costs, IDs, loadouts, associations, category ownership, Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS38
This catalogue now targets Game System revision 38. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE — THOUSAND SONS 3.3.5 / GS40
Thousand Sons 3.3.5 targets Game System revision 40 and uses the current Leader Points, Practice, Extra Unit Copy Costs, Unit Abilities, Great Traitors’ Arsenal, and presentation infrastructure. All 15 native selectable roots retain their stable IDs, points, categories, loadouts, attachment behavior, paid wargear, Rare handling, and validation unless explicitly listed in the September 19th Changelog section.

Exalted Sorcerer, Discborne Exalted Sorcerer, Infernal Master, Time Cult Sorcerer, and Tzaangor Shaman retain their existing intrinsic 1 LP costs. Scarab Occult Sorcerer and Aspiring Sorcerer remain 0-LP Leaders with no LP cost object and retain their source-derived 0 leader points rules. Exalted Sorcerer and Discborne Exalted Sorcerer are the two  command roots; the other paid and 0-LP Leaders remain unbadged.

Great Traitors’ Arsenal remains an automatically present Configuration with Not Included as the default. Included exposes the 28 stable roots from the current Chaos Space Marines 3.3.6 Arsenal Library V28. This consumer owns availability and its copy-cost arithmetic; intrinsic Arsenal points, Leader Points, loadouts, validation, presentation, and Unit Abilities remain library-owned.

Extra Unit Copy Costs uses one visible accounting entry while preserving distinct Troop and Other arithmetic. Rubric Marines (3), Tzaangors (9), Arsenal Legionaries (5), and Arsenal Cultists (10) remain four independent Troop families. Five native non-Rare Other families plus twenty eligible Arsenal Other families retain their existing accounting. Practice / Quick / Standard / Long normal-copy allowances are 4 / 4 / 6 / 8 for Troops and 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 for Other.

AUTHORING / PRESENTATION NOTES
Unit rows use ◆ ; 🧰 marks Loadout Options; immediate model-role headers use the Thousand Sons 👁️ marker; listbuilder-relevant Leader attachment associations/rules use 🔗; and Infantry, Vehicle, Monster, and Rare category labels use the current Game System icons. Top-level Unit Ability names are represented as shared Profiles for all 15 native Thousand Sons datasheets; nested sub-abilities are intentionally omitted. The supplied Unit Ability map also contains Summoned Screamers, Summoned Flamers, Summoned Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch, and Summoned Pink Horrors, but REV20 contains no corresponding catalogue structures, so no fabricated entries or profiles are created for them.

OPTIONAL UNIT ABILITY PRESENTATION: top-level abilities granted by selectable upgrades are linked to the upgrade rather than the unit root, so New Recruit displays them only when that option is selected. Icon of Flame is linked to the Rubric Marines upgrade, and Mutating Horrors is linked to the Mutalith Vortex Beast upgrade.

REVISION HISTORY
REV17 and earlier established the current Great Traitors’ Arsenal Configuration, native/Arsenal soft-copy accounting, New Recruit-compatible cost types, constructive validation, loadout presentation, and checkbox-style paid upgrades.
REV18 — LEADER POINTS MIGRATION
Retargeted the catalogue to Game System revision 24. Exalted Sorcerer, Discborne Exalted Sorcerer, Infernal Master, Time Cult Sorcerer, and Tzaangor Shaman now each cost 1 LP. Scarab Occult Sorcerer and Aspiring Sorcerer remain without LP cost objects and retain the source wording that they cost 0 leader points. Great Traitors’ Arsenal, attachment validation, Additional Copy Costs, points, loadouts, and unrelated mechanics were unchanged.
REV19 — LEADER POINTS CLEANUP
Runtime validation passed for the Thousand Sons Leader Points implementation. The legacy Counts Toward Leader Maximum semantics were removed where superseded by intrinsic LP costs. Scarab Occult Sorcerer and Aspiring Sorcerer remain 0 LP by absence of an LP cost object. Arsenal behavior and unrelated faction mechanics remained unchanged.
REV20 — UNIT SIZE NAME PRESENTATION
Added source model-count suffixes to Rubric Marines (3), Tzaangors (9), Scarab Occult Terminators (2), Tzaangor Enlightened (3), and Sekhetar Robots (2). Stable IDs, points, categories, loadouts, attachment topology, Additional Copy Cost arithmetic, Leader Points, Arsenal behavior, and validation mechanics remained unchanged. The touched catalogue was compatibility-only retargeted to Game System revision 26.

REV21 — CURRENT TEMPLATE / PRACTICE / UNIT ABILITIES / ARSENAL V20 SYNC
Consolidated the current-template update from the live REV20 baseline. Retargeted to Game System revision 37; renamed and flattened Extra Unit Copy Costs while preserving all existing Quick/Standard/Long native and Arsenal arithmetic; added 420 Point Practice compatibility; adopted the current unit/loadout/model/category/attachment presentation; marked Exalted Sorcerer and Discborne Exalted Sorcerer as the selective  command tier; added top-level Unit Ability profiles for all 15 native datasheets; and synchronized all 28 Great Traitors’ Arsenal consumer display names to the corrected Chaos Space Marines 3.3.6 Arsenal Library V20. Nested sub-abilities and ability-map-only summoned daemons are intentionally omitted. Stable root IDs, points, Leader Points, loadout constraints, attachment topology, Rare validation, paid wargear, Arsenal target IDs, and all unrelated faction semantics remain unchanged.
